channel.title: Palm AI Blog
channel.description: Insights for builders' merchants, plumbers' merchants, tool hire, electrical and foodservice wholesalers.

item.title: What is basket analysis? A plain English guide for trade merchants
item.description: Basket analysis sounds technical. It isn't. It's simply understanding what your customers buy together — and spotting what's missing. Here's how it works in practice.
item.author: Jonathan Pritchard

item.title: Share of wallet: what it means for wholesalers and how to grow it
item.description: Share of wallet isn't a finance term. For wholesalers and distributors, it's the single most important number you're probably not tracking. Here's why it matters.
item.author: Jonathan Pritchard

item.title: Why sales engagement platforms fail SMEs — and what to do instead
item.description: Around 22% of SMEs cite integration difficulties as their main barrier to adopting sales technology. But the real problem isn't the integration. It's the assumption that you need to replace everything first.
item.author: Jonathan Pritchard

item.title: Your tool hire accounts are hiring one thing from you and everything else from someone else
item.description: A contractor who hires compaction equipment from you every month but sources generators, welfare units and access towers elsewhere isn't a full account — they're a fraction of one. Here's how depots are closing that gap.
item.author: Jonathan Pritchard

item.title: Why foodservice wholesalers lose kitchens to split ordering — and never see it happen
item.description: A restaurant that orders your dairy and dry goods every week but sources fresh produce and fish elsewhere isn't a lost account. It's an account you never fully had. Here's how wholesalers are closing that gap.
item.author: Jonathan Pritchard

item.title: A plain-English glossary: 8 trade merchant terms explained simply
item.description: No jargon, no long words. Just 8 terms you'll actually hear — explained the way you'd explain them to someone on their first day.
item.author: Jonathan Pritchard

item.title: Why your best customers are buying from your competitors — and you probably won't know until it's too late
item.description: Most trade merchants don't lose customers in one go. They lose them category by category, quietly, over months. Here's how to spot it before it's too late.
item.author: Jonathan Pritchard
